result.keyword: What's the best accounting software for a small business?
result.markdown:
For most small businesses, I would recommend **QuickBooks Online** as the best all-around accounting software. However, depending on the size of your business, budget, and how you handle invoicing, there may be a better option.

Since you're in Canada, I've focused on software that supports Canadian businesses, including GST/HST.

## My top 5 accounting software choices

![QuickBooks Online Subscription
– Youngblüm Consulting, LLC](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/ZgHrB8oigEufRyuFGAnJb5xLCv8JTTFTuh-tJroDHKA-im6xXYHUKY5IyXqMXAn4XiAmA9iGGDzvBmRzmuCP5nnYiezowZhOKrQixuB8tQOCn-kwmHGQPey_5_wckO7vbwWRLyIGGAJrospfP2duINJHsMT-PeUh6ztD0dM7ZAm_N6XnyQYoxFtq7J7pZOxm?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. QuickBooks Online**

(Best overall)

- Excellent bookkeeping and financial reports
- Tracks income, expenses and GST/HST
- Invoicing, payroll options and inventory
- Widely supported by Canadian accountants

**Typical price\:** Starting around C\$20/month.

[QuickBooks Canada website](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/ca/)

---

![Xero – AccountKit Support Center](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/HOFZdHQfaXHdQ0Jl6FhQm1ZL8WDa2JXXY2s_IDNQw6_ClmY--iV2XW1k6Glaj1ICzU7IfOAztiKsPODuDYTSIw6PRmUslgzmZ5aMlPuGROKkGMtSJzGnCUzu5B8zEx6lZO3rd6Y_GILZvoN2_MXkKzeqqLSGOUSO0lv-UiE7fZFfvbCSDizWo5sdMixvhee4?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Xero**

(Best for growing businesses)

- Clean, easy-to-use interface
- Unlimited users on all plans
- Excellent bank reconciliation
- Good financial reporting

**Typical price\:** C\$25–\$80/month.

[Xero Canada website](https://www.xero.com/ca/)

---

![Free Wave Financial Inc. Logo Vector Download | Logowik](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/tnsMywbhmGAbFqPGr6O6DRlr31UIPIOPlNOMdf6um-89wvuooxUnVR2zBx_BWRY62sU-oEIrmhWudT2Iq__WN2d_uJSl7RY3WikgQVspfhcPs3tKMFKFs5Xx7GT_25_4ERvIXrsRVuZT0eEu7vba7OwhSfn0VtBIomBp5nrMl6pAjSavjUdtqHSynMOahhsM?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Wave Accounting**

(Best budget option)

- Free basic accounting plan
- Easy invoicing
- Income and expense tracking
- Suitable for sole proprietors and small businesses

**Typical price\:** Free basic plan; Pro around C\$25/month.

[Wave website](https://www.waveapps.com/)

---

![FreshBooks Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/RRvX6v49QkXlAnGf7iI3zuYuHq4Y5bCV2ND2uEGJjfjlSbrrgGFSfhAMTnFz47xKgD07CO5bDVnhMBo6jF3Yychs84_UW4qLs93k9PAEnaI8Kmr_xSKldMl1tHK69I4mDHX1xQ085ifzPdaKSnwyxyG_Y5668gw33P8XIfpZgJ8Lv3nST9TCXoqpEHKBFC7o?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. FreshBooks**

(Best for freelancers)

- Very easy invoicing
- Tracks billable hours
- Expense management
- Good for service-based businesses

**Typical price\:** C\$26–\$72/month.

[FreshBooks Canada website](https://www.freshbooks.com/en-ca)

---

!["Best 10 Zoho Apps for Small Businesses in 2024 - Must-Have Tools" | C3 Solutions](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/QMBJut4kUVy6UNtA0DcEcpSKElNdEgHfabBOoR3AWTMUo6phHjAJ01KBTRk_iU44CUuVy6AD0OeM48UFtluYC3mtudqFVjYFesk47WQPcQQfsgxz1-Ctp0z-lODm5vgYFvDQ7IEjwcEwqAsNX1booH4Twqog2tqxnwaLYmRuRR9TviU8hG6khxNJKfVoO6Q2?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Zoho Books**

(Best value)

- Strong bookkeeping features
- Automated workflows
- Customer and vendor management
- Integrates with other Zoho products

**Typical price\:** Free option available for qualifying businesses; paid plans available.

[Zoho Books Canada website](https://www.zoho.com/ca/books/)

Pricing is approximate in Canadian dollars and can change. ## Which one would I choose?

| Business type | My recommendation |
|--------|--------|
| Small general business | QuickBooks |
| Construction or contracting | QuickBooks |
| Retail or inventory business | QuickBooks |
| Multiple employees/users | Xero |
| Freelance or consulting | FreshBooks |
| Very small business on a budget | Wave |
| Business already using Zoho | Zoho Books |
